windows.60: Visitors have raised concerns about the food offerings, describing the menu as limited and the quality as poor, with specific complaints about items like potato salad and grilled cheese. Some reviewers found the food overpriced and noted a lack of basic amenities such as cups for water. Service and wait times were also mentioned, though less frequently. Overall, the library received an average rating of 4.3 from 10 reviews, but two critical reviews highlight areas for improvement, particularly in food quality and menu variety.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests reported long wait times and limited menu availability, with some noting that the kitchen was backed up and only grab-and-go options were offered late in the day. Many found the food overpriced relative to its quality and portion size, and some described the menu choices as limited or poorly executed. Service delays and pricing were common concerns, while fewer comments addressed the atmosphere. Addressing the food service logistics and menu offerings could improve visitor satisfaction.
